articles.summary: Bluemercury, a leading luxury beauty retailer and Macy's, Inc. nameplate, today announced the appointment of Stacie Borteck Dattner as Vice President/General Merchandise Manager, Merchandising, effective October 12. She will report directly to Alexandre Choueiri, Chief Executive Officer of Bluemercury. In this role, Dattner will lead Bluemercury's merchandising strategy, proprietary brands, and vendor marketing, guiding the retailer's assortment and strengthening its distinctive point of view on luxury beauty. She will oversee how Bluemercury identifies, curates and brings to market the brands, products and innovations that resonate with its clients, while creating new opportunities for discovery across the Bluemercury experience. Dattner joins Bluemercury following nearly two decades at Bloomingdale's, where she held a range of senior merchandising and leadership roles, including seven years leading its beauty and fragrance division. articles.summary: Bluemercury , the trusted and elevated neighborhood beauty destination, today announced the evolution of Lune+Aster , its proprietary makeup brand. Introducing a refreshed visual identity, enhanced assortment and new "Beauty, Uncomplicated" positioning, the launch is designed to make prestige beauty intuitive, approachable and adaptable for all. The evolution reflects Bluemercury's broader consumer-led growth strategy, rooted in deep client understanding, expert curation and differentiated beauty experiences. As beauty consumers increasingly seek streamlined routines, trusted guidance and more intentional choices, Bluemercury continues to evolve its assortment to meet their needs. Lune+Aster's refreshed offering complements Bluemercury's portfolio of iconic luxury makeup brands, making discovery easier through exceptional products and personalized expertise.
